purpose: Separate collectible interaction removal from the ARE re-stream lifecycle for pickups and puzzle letters.
conclusions: Collection consumes the live object immediately by clearing object+0x18.

Because the accepted interaction path does not call 1DEE, it does not clear the ARE record claim used by re-streaming; the collected object is not re-created by the normal off-camera scan in the same loaded ARE buffer.
Level selection is observed to reread the W1L2.ARE resource, so a fresh level load rebuilds the source buffer; whether a separate persistent collected-bit suppresses reconstruction remains untested.
